en.t: I tried to stammer inside my mouth.

units.source_text: 一句话就简直像平时将手插入深口袋时寻找东西，物品被别的东西挂住怎么也抱不出来一样，

en.t: A single word was just like the way, when I usually put my hand into a deep pocket to search for something, the object gets caught on something else and I cannot bring it out no matter what,

units.source_text: 让我万分焦灼，这时活儿才到了嘴边。

en.t: it made me unbearably impatient, and only then did the word finally reach my lips.

units.source_text: 我内心世界的沉重和浓度，恰似今晚的黑夜，

en.t: The heaviness and density of my inner world were just like the darkness of tonight,

units.source_text: 语言就像沉重的吊桶，从那深夜的水井里发出了咯吱吱的声音升了上来。

en.t: and language, like a heavy well bucket, rose from that midnight well with a creaking sound.
